scope: Only the four audited Fable/Mythos web-search model-to-capability joins; no full provider refresh
method: Built-in web open/read of the current official guide, its linked tool reference and four exact model overview pages; capability-specific text review. Searches of the successfully opened model pages found no Web search assertion.

sources.summary: Dynamic filtering is described for Claude 4.6 and later and Mythos Preview. The page retains organization, tool-version and programmatic-tool conditions, and points to tool reference for compatibility. It does not directly name the four audited Fable/Mythos identities as supported.
Server web-search tools are listed; model compatibility is tool/version-specific and delegated back to individual tool pages. No additional Fable/Mythos-specific compatibility bridge is supplied.
Exact model identity and agentic/research descriptions do not establish web-search tool compatibility.
Exact invitation-only identity and shared Fable 5.1 specifications/pricing do not directly specify web-search compatibility.
Exact model identity and general capability description do not directly bind this identity to web-search tool support.
Exact invitation-only identity and shared Fable 5 specifications/pricing do not directly establish web-search support.

decision: Four joins downgraded from INFERRED_HIGH to INFERRED_MEDIUM and deferred. Missing bridge is uncertainty, not proof of unsupported capability. Eight existing Opus/Sonnet members were outside this recheck and remain unchanged.
publicationBoundary: Research confidence correction only; no authenticated entitlement, execution probe, source-priority change, lifecycle redesign or Apply.
